svg.title: atomiX boron-ion probability-cloud logo
svg.desc: The atomiX wordmark beside a boron-10 nucleus of five green protons and five blue neutrons. Dense equal-weight samples from exact hydrogen-like B4+ probability densities form projected 1s, 2p x, and 3d xy clouds. The clouds are rendered brighter and denser for logo readability while preserving mathematically correct sampling.
